texto.es: Nos cuentas qué quieres renovar (cocina, closet, baño) y te escuchamos las ideas desde el primer contacto.
texto.en: Tell us what you want renovated (kitchen, closet, bath) and we listen to your ideas from the first contact.

texto.es: Revisamos el espacio y proponemos ajustes de diseño para aprovechar cada rincón de la cocina.
texto.en: We review the space and suggest design adjustments to make the most of every corner of the kitchen.

texto.es: Construimos los gabinetes a medida y los instalamos con el cuidado que describen nuestros clientes.
texto.en: We build the cabinets to measure and install them with the same care our clients describe.

texto.es: Revisamos juntos el resultado terminado antes de darlo por entregado.
texto.en: We walk the finished result together before calling the job done.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el proyecto. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the project. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Un cambio completo de gabinetes, como la renovación que hicimos para Juan Andres: de principio a fin.
texto.en: A complete cabinet overhaul, like the remodel we did for Juan Andres: from start to finish.

texto.es: Diseñamos y construimos gabinetes a la medida exacta de tu cocina, con atención personalizada en cada etapa.
texto.en: We design and build cabinetry to your kitchen's exact measurements, with personalized attention at every stage.

texto.es: Te ayudamos a personalizar tu cocina de punta a punta, como el proyecto que terminamos con Erica en cerca de un mes.
texto.en: We help you customize your kitchen end to end, like the project we finished with Erica in about a month.

texto.es: Baños y closets con el mismo nivel de acabado que ves en nuestras cocinas, el mismo equipo responsable.
texto.en: Bathrooms and closets finished to the same standard you see in our kitchens, by the same accountable crew.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos y te confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: I recently had the pleasure of working with Latino Carpentry Finish for a complete overhaul of my kitchen cabinets, and I am absolutely thrilled with the results. From start to finish, their service and craftsmanship have been exceptional.

I want to send a special thank you to Victor and his team for the amazing work they did on remodeling my kitchen. They were extremely patient with me and guided me every step of the way. They went above and beyond to ensure I ended up with the kitchen I wanted.

Victor is a very responsible worker. He understands clients requests and offers reasonable suggestions and options when needed. I highly recommend him as a persona and as an efficient clean/hard working professional. He did my whole kitchen, bathrooms and closets.
